name: overlapping-bubbles
provenance: Authored by hand by the Test Developer (claude-opus-5) for MT-007 RED on 2026-09-15. Wholly synthetic.
purpose: AC-3. Two components whose BOUNDING BOXES overlap - B's lies wholly inside A's - while not one pixel is shared. Pixel-level overlap between two components is impossible by definition (it would be one component), so this is what 'two components whose masks overlap' can mean.

paint.note: left bar of the L, contiguous with A-top
sits in the L's notch, 16px clear of both arms

notes: A's bbox is [20,20,140,140]; B's bbox is [60,60,120,120] and lies wholly inside it.
The 16px clearance survives 2 iterations of a 7x7 kernel: each grows by 6px, closing 12px of the 16px gap, so the two stay separate components at the shipped dilation.
ONE box covers both, so 'two regions' is a claim about connected components rather than about the box count.
